items.name: Dotspace Foundation
items.description: dotSPACE is a not-for-profit foundation. An open-innovation network for geodata-based innovation. We are focused on education, exploration & creation with remote sensing technologies. In today’s data-driven world, it is important to explore the possibilities and the future opportunities of remote sensing. We exchange knowledge and ideas, foster entrepreneurship and collaborate to develop new initiatives. The foundation supports development of new solutions and pushes the boundaries of what is possible with earth observation data.

items.name: Ecosmic
items.description: Ecosmic is a consultancy start-up that aims at supporting space industries that are willing to decrease their environmental impact.

items.name: Eye On Orbit
items.description: Eye On Orbit is devoted to bringing developments in space exploration and commerce to society and business. To the stars and beyond! Eye On Orbit  provides independent, reliable, creative and focused expertise to projects carried out by Space organizations worldwide, backed by its many years of experience in (system-) engineering of optomechanical space instrumentation.

items.name: Schonenborg Space Engineering BV
items.description: Schonenborg Space Engineering B.V. develops ISS flight hardware for experimental and support purposes. In addition consultancy for space engineering and project management is provided.

items.name: Leiden Institute for Air Law
items.description: Leiden University’s Institute of Air and Space Law advances research and education on aviation and space law and policy.
